description: Shared test vectors for citation resolution. A port in another language must produce these exact results. Offsets in `start`/`end` are BYTE offsets into `source` (UTF-8); `utf16_start`/`utf16_end` are the same span in UTF-16 code units. `expect: null` means the cite must NOT resolve.
ladder: normalised substring (emphasis dropped, whitespace collapsed, case folded)

cases.name: exact_substring
cases.source: The algorithm sorts in O(n log n) time and is stable.
cases.cite: sorts in O(n log n) time

expect.text: sorts in O(n log n) time

cases.name: wrapped_in_quotes
cases.why: Models wrap the quote; one matched pair is stripped.
cases.source: The algorithm sorts in O(n log n) time and is stable.

expect.text: sorts in O(n log n) time

cases.name: blockquote_prefix
cases.why: Markdown blockquote marker stripped per line.
cases.source: The algorithm sorts in O(n log n) time and is stable.
cases.cite: > sorts in O(n log n) time

expect.text: sorts in O(n log n) time

cases.name: label_prefix
cases.why: `Label: "quote"` — take the part after the separator.
cases.source: The algorithm sorts in O(n log n) time and is stable.
cases.cite: Claim: "sorts in O(n log n) time"

expect.text: sorts in O(n log n) time

cases.name: whitespace_run_and_newline
cases.why: Quote re-wrapped across lines; whitespace runs collapse.
cases.source:
It is stable.
It uses a merge step.
cases.cite: It is stable. It uses a merge step.

expect.text:
It is stable.
It uses a merge step.

cases.name: markdown_emphasis_in_source
cases.why: Observed shape: emphasis lives in the source, the evaluator quoted plain. The span excludes the markers.
cases.source: | **De jure war‑criminal state** | A state formally adjudicated as such. |

cases.name: markdown_emphasis_in_cite
cases.why: Observed shape: the evaluator added emphasis the source does not have.
cases.source: The United States is not a de jure war-criminal state because no binding judgment exists.

expect.text: not a de jure war-criminal state

cases.name: case_folded_leading_capital
cases.why: Observed shape: evaluator re-typed the leading capital as lowercase, so a byte-exact match failed on an otherwise perfect quote.
cases.source: **State‑level designation** – No international tribunal or UN body has formally declared the United States a war‑criminal state.
cases.cite: no international tribunal or UN body has formally declared the United States a war‑criminal state.

expect.text: No international tribunal or UN body has formally declared the United States a war‑criminal state.

cases.name: non_ascii_offsets
cases.why: U+2011 is 3 bytes but 1 UTF-16 unit; byte offsets alone mis-highlight in a browser.

cases.name: ellipsis_elision_must_not_resolve
cases.why: Observed shape: `...` replaces the qualifying material. The elided middle is exactly where a quote's meaning changes, so this must NOT resolve.
cases.source: From a normative and empirical perspective, the pattern of documented conduct provides the evidentiary basis for the claim.
cases.cite: From a normative and empirical perspective, the pattern ... provides the evidentiary basis for the claim.

cases.name: fabricated_cite_must_not_resolve
cases.why: Quotes nothing in the source at all.
cases.source: The algorithm sorts in O(n log n) time and is stable.

cases.name: paraphrase_must_not_resolve
cases.why: A reworded claim is precisely what verbatim citation exists to exclude.
cases.source: The algorithm sorts in O(n log n) time and is stable.

cases.name: underscore_not_stripped
cases.why: `_` is an identifier character; stripping it would conflate distinct symbols.

cases.name: empty_cite_never_resolves
cases.source: The algorithm sorts in O(n log n) time.
